On Nakba Day, our St. Louis community came together to commemorate 78 years since the occupation of Palestine began.

I will always stand against genocide, even as millions of dollars are spent to scare our movement into silence. Speak out!

Video

We had an amazing evening at the Bashiri Asad Memorial Day celebration!

I always have fun supporting STL’s diverse community of musicians and artists. 

Thank you to the event organizers and to everyone who came out to support independent artists and the creatives of the St. Louis area and beyond.

Yesterday, alongside Mayor Sharon Pace, Northwoods city officials, and community members, I had the honor of celebrating the results of $850,000 in Community Project Funding that my office secured for Northwoods when I represented Missouri’s 1st District.

These funds went to the renovation of Northwoods City Park, upgrading walkways, play areas for children, and other park amenities for local families.

When I return to Congress, I'll keep fighting to bring home the critical funding our neighbo

Thank you Bostel TV St. Louis for inviting me on your show and for talking with me about the issues facing the Bosnian community here in STL.

I’m committed to making sure that St. Louis is a great place to live for all our immigrant communities and fighting back against xenophobia, Islamophobia and all forms of discrimination.

Thank you to everyone who joined us for Conversations with Cori on Sunday afternoon!

I loved hearing from community members from Northwoods and across North County about what you want to see from your leaders and how we can come together to meet this political moment.

If you couldn’t make it, keep an eye out for our next Conversations with Cori! This is a people-powered movement, and we need to come together and organize to build it.
Find our next event here!: mobilize.us/coribush1/

SATURDAY JUNE 6TH:

Join Cori, the team, and supporters at Aloe Plaza to tailgate and cheer on the Bosnia and Herzegovina National Soccer Team as they come to St. Louis to play their last game before the World Cup!

We need help from volunteers like you to make our celebration come together.
RSVP here to volunteer as we table for Cori, engage with the community, and root for the team! mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

MoveOn has built a grassroots movement fueled by everyday people, and I’m excited to have their support as I run to return to Congress.

Together, we’re building an infrastructure to protect our voting rights, fight back against Trump, and ensure that our political and economic system answers to the people, not corporations or the wealthy few.

We’ll keep building our progressive movement to make sure we win our race on August 4th.

Eid Mubarak, St. Louis!

To all who are celebrating Eid Al-Adha in St. Louis and beyond, I’m praying for blessings for you and your family.
Impact, Not Big PACs: Send Cori Back nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1DGleeVNq…

We had an amazing time at the STL Punk Rock Flea Market in Tower Grove Park!

It was so much fun to support local vendors and hear live music from independent artists.

STL loves our small businesses and our arts community!

I’m truly humbled to have the endorsement of icon, actress, author, and activist Jenifer Lewis as I run to return to Congress and keep fighting for St. Louis’ families!

In this moment where our voting rights and our Democracy are under attack, our movement to fight back against Trump and deliver for STL grows every day.

It's great to have such a strong fighter joining us.

Video

NEXT WEEK!

Join us for the launch of Latinos for Cori!

On June 1st, we’re coming together for a virtual phonebank! We need bilingual volunteers from all over to help us have conversations with Spanish-first communities in St. Louis about the issues affecting us here in the 1st District.

Then, on June 6th, we’re joining together with our St. Louis Latino community to organize, mobilize, and fight for progressive values by canvassing in the Dutchtown area!

It was another fantastic year connecting at the African Arts Festival!

It’s always beautiful to see our St. Louis community come together to celebrate and support African art, culture, and educational programs.

See you next year!
